s: Dine hashala vehaskara lenokri beshabbat ubo y"t seipim: muttar lehashil kelim ulehaskiram lenokri veap al pi shehannokri oseh bahem melaka beshabbat, mippene sheen anu metzuvvin al shebitat hakkelim shellanu shello yaaseh bahem hannokri melaka beshabbat, o shello teaseh bahen melaka beshabbat meeleha, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman rn"b (uleinyan lehaskir dabar shel parhesya, ayyen simman rm"g). Ukeshennotel hassakar — lo yittol sekar hashshabbat ella behablaa, kegon im hiskir lo leshabua o lechodesh yakol littol hassakar ap shessekar hashshabbat mubla bo, abal im hiskir lo leyamim nipradim bead kol yom veyom kak vekak — lo yittol mimmennu sakar hammaggia lime hashshabbat, kemo shennitbaer besimman rm"g, ayyen sham. Vaapillu im hiskir lo yisrael kelim sheen osim bahem melaka kelal, vaapillu hiskir lo cheder ladur bo — lo yittol sekar shabbat ella behablaa (ayyen simman sh"v):

Yesh omerim shehakkelim sheosim bahem melaka, kegon rechayim bemaqom shemuttar lehaskiram lenokri, kemo shennitbaer besimman rm"g, umacharesha vekayyotze bahen mishshear kele ummanut — asur lehaskiram lenokri beereb shabbat, dekevan sheyyesh revach lehayyisrael bemah shehakkelim niskarim lenokri gam beyom hashshabbat, ki yadua hu ap shemmaskiram lo leshabua o lechodesh im haya maskir lo chutz mishabbatot shello haya rashshay laasot bahem melaka gam beshabbat — haya hannokri pochet lo meat missekirut shennoten akshav keshemmaskir lo setam veyesh lo reshut laasot gam beshabbat, lepikak keshehannokri oseh melaka beshabbat samuk leyom shehiskiram lo dehaynu ereb shabbat — hare nireh keillu oseh bishlichut hayyisrael shetztzivvahu laasot beshabbat keshehiskiram lo etmol, kevan sheyyesh revach leyisrael bemah shehu rashshay laasot beshabbat. Veken iqqar:

Abal lehashil lo kelim sheosim bahem melaka — muttar apillu beereb shabbat samuk lachasheka, dekevan sheen revach leyisrael bemah shehannokri rashshay laasot bahem beshabbat — en nireh keillu oseh bishlichuto. Vaapillu im mashilo bitnay al menat sheyyashilennu hannokri keli acher leachar hashshabbat, venimtza sheyyesh revach leyisrael bemah shemmashil lehannokri gam beshabbat, mikkol maqom kevan sheeno notel sekirut mammash bead zeh — lo gazeru chakamim:

Asur lehashil shum chepetz lenokri beshabbat, vaapillu beereb shabbat, im hu samuk lachasheka kol kak ad sheen shahut lannokri lehotzi hachepetz mippetach beto shel hayyisrael lirshut harabbim mibbeod yom — asur lehashilo, mippene marit haayin, sheharoeh et hannokri yotze mibbet hayyisrael vechepetz yisrael beyado yachshod et hayyisrael shehu sholeach chapatzayv beshabbat al yede nokri zeh, shello yaaleh al dato shehishil lo vehu motzio letzorek atzmo. Vaapillu beir sheen bah reshut harabbim ella karmelit, sheen issur shel tora apillu leyisrael lehotzi letokah mereshut hayyachid, ap al pi ken kevan shemmiddibre soperim asur lehotzi apillu al yede nokri shello letzorek mitzva kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"z, im ken yachsheduhu shehu ober al dibre soperim:

Abal beir hamorebet shemmuttar letaltel betokah — muttar lehashilo apillu beshabbat im hannokri dar bemaqom hamorab shemmuttar letaltel bo. O apillu dar bemaqom sheeno meorab, ella beinyan sheen lachush lemarit haayin shel haroeh oto yotze mibbeto shel yisrael (kegon shebbeto shel yisrael rachoq kol kak mimmaqom sheeno meorab, beinyan sheharoeh oto yotze mibbeto shel yisrael eno roeh keshehu yotze lemaqom sheeno meorab). Umikkol maqom, im yadua lo shehannokri yolikennu hayyom chutz lattechum — asur lehashilo beshabbat, lepi shecheptzo shel yisrael shehayu birshuto beben hashshemashot qanu etzlo shebita bishbitato, dehaynu alpayim amma lekol ruach velo yoter. Veap sheen adam muzhar al techum kelayv kemo sheeno metzuvveh al shebitat kelayv, mikkol maqom kevan sheqqanu shebita etzlo veen lahem ella alpayim amma — asur lo ligrom lahem beyadayim sheyyubeu chutz lattechum al yede shemmosero beyad nokri. Abal muttar leharotam lo velomar lo sheyyittelem meatzmo, kevan sheeno moseram lo beyadayim. Veyesh mattirin apillu limsor lo beyadayim, kevan shehannokri hu hammotzian chutz lattechum middato letzorek atzmo, vehayyisrael eno ella gorem beolma. Veken iqqar. Veyesh choleqin al kol zeh veomerim, sheapillu beir hamorebet, vaapillu hannokri dar gam ken bemaqom hamorab — asur lehashilo beshabbat, o apillu beereb shabbat kol sheeno yotze mippetach beto mibbeod yom, lepi sheharoeh oto yotze mibbet yisrael beshabbat vechepetz yisrael beyado yomar shemmakar lo chepetz zeh beshabbat, o hilvahu lo lizman merubbeh (dehaynu yoter mil' yom shehi niqret halvaa), velo hittiru beshabbat ella sheela shehu lizman muat kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"z, o yomar (haroeh) shennetano lo lemashkon, veasur litten mashkon beshabbat kemo sheyyitbaer sham, o yomar shennetano lo letaqqeno velaasot bo melaka, veasur litten beshabbat shum dabar laasot bo melaka apillu beqabbelanut, vaapillu qatzatz immo meereb shabbat. Uleinyan halaka, yesh lehaqel bishela beet hatztzorek kisbara harishona. Abal im makar lo apillu beereb shabbat, o shehilvahu lo lizman merubbeh yoter mishsheloshim yom, o shennetano lo lemashkon, o shennetano laasot bo melaka — tzarik sheyyetze mippetach beto mibbeod yom apillu hi ir hamorebet, lepi sheyyesh lachush shemma yivvada leharoeh oto yotze mibbet yisrael shehayyisrael mekaro lo, o hilvahu, o mishkeno, o netano lo laasot bo melaka, kevan shekken hu haemet, veyachshedehu sheasa ken beshabbat, mah sheen ken bishela kesheyyivvada lo haemet — en kan chashad kelal ap im yidmeh lo shehishilo beshabbat, shehare muttar lehashil beshabbat:

Vekol zeh bachapatzim shel yisrael, abal chapatzim shel nokri shehayu mupqadim beyad yisrael uba littelo beshabbat — yakol litteno veap al pi sheyyotziennu lirshut harabbim, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shk"h, ayyen sham tashlum dinim ellu:

Asur lehashil behemto lenokri laasot bah melaka, mippene shehannokri oseh bah gam beshabbat, veadam metzuvveh al shebitat behemto, shenneemar "lemaan yanuach shoreka vachamoreka". Veap lehaskirah lo asur min hattora, ap al pi shemmaskirah harbeh yamim qodem hashshabbat, vaapillu im matneh immo shello yaaseh bah kelum beshabbat vehibtiach lo — en zeh moil, ki en hannokri neeman al kak, mittaam sheyyitbaer besimman sh"h, ayyen sham:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheggup habbehema shel yisrael, abal yisrael shessakar behema minnokri — yakol lachazor ulehaskirah o lehashilah lenokri acher, dekevan sheen gup habbehema shello — eno metzuvveh al shebitatah. Veyesh mi sheoser lehashilah, lepi sheyyesh lehistappeq shemma al yede hassekirut shessekarah hayyisrael, shennoten damim lehannokri baadah kede sheyyehe rashshay laasot bah melaka, niqneh lo al yede kak habbehema leyamim ellu shessekarah lo mehannokri, ukeshechozer umashilah lenokri vehannokri oseh bah melaka beshabbat — ober hayyisrael mishshum shebitat behemto, mah sheen ken keshechozer umaskirah lenokri — muttar, mimma napshak, sheim niqneh gup habbehema leyisrael — niqneh gam ken lenokri shessekarah mimmennu, veen hayyisrael metzuvveh al shebitatah. Vetob lachush lidbarayv:

Muttar lehaskir o lehashil behemto lenokri ulehatnot immo sheyyachazirenna lo qodem hashshabbat. Veim abar hannokri al tenao veikkebah velo hechezirah qodem hashshabbat — yapqirenna hayyisrael beno leben atzmo qodem hashshabbat, sheaz eno metzuvveh al shebitatah, kevan sheenah shello, shekkebar hipqirah. Veap al pi shemmiddibre soperim kol hepqer sheeno bipne shelosha eno hepqer kelal, shekkesheyyesh shelosha bevadday hu mapqir beleb shalem, veen kan chashash haarama, shehare echad mehashshelosha yakol lizkot miyyad bahepqer hazzeh, vehashshenayim hannisharim yekolim lehaid lo shezzaka mehahepqer, velo yukal hammapqir lachazor bo ulehotzio mimmennu, mikkol maqom ap al pi shemmapqir beno leben atzmo — bevadday mapqir beleb shalem, kede sheyyinnatzel meissur shel tora. Umikkol maqom, en adam acher yakol lizkot bah apillu im mapqirah bipne shelosha kishar hepqer, dekevan sheenah mapqirah ella kede lehapqia mealayv issur shabbat bilbad, im ken min hassetam eno mapqirah ella leyom hashshabbat bilbad, beshaa shehannokri oseh bah melaka, shehepqer leyom echad o apillu leshaa achat hare hu hepqer gamur leoto yom veotah shaa, kemo sheyyitbaer bechoshen mishpat simman ra"g. Ubemotzae shabbat miyyad hi chozeret lihyot shello, veen shum adam yakol lizkot bah. Veap beshabbat enah hepqer ella beshaa sheoseh bah melaka, shehare lo hipqirah ella kede lehinnatzel meissur asiyyat hammelaka shehannokri oseh bah beshabbat, veim ken beshaa sheeno oseh bah kelum hi chozeret lihyot shello, veen shum adam yakol lizkot bah. (Ella beshaa shehannokri oseh bah, veaz lo yannichennu hannokri. Veap im yannichennu hannokri, mikkol maqom otah rega shezzokeh bah hi betela mimmeleket hannokri, vechozeret hi lihyot shel yisrael):

Veim hu rotzeh yakol lehaqnot gup habbehema lenokri zeh leyom hashshabbat qodem hashshabbat, vehu sheyyomar lo bepanayv behemti qenuya leka, sheaz mitkavven hannokri liqnotah, vehi niqnet lo baamira zo kevan shehi birshuto, abal im omer ken shello bepanayv — lo qenaah hannokri kelal:

Vekol zeh bediabad, shekkebar hiskirah o hishilah lenokri behetter, shehitna immo sheyyachazirenna lo qodem hashshabbat, abal lekattechilla asur lehaskirah o lehashilah setam al semak shekkesheyyaggia hashshabbat yapqirenna o yaqneh otah lehannokri, lepi shemmepursam larabbim shehi behemat yisrael, vehahepqer vehahaqnaa enan mepursamim kelal, veyesh kan chashash marit haayin. Veyesh mattirin lehaskir o lehashil lekattechilla al semak shekkesheyyaggia hashshabbat yapqirenna o yaqneh otah lehannokri bipne shelosha yisreelim, sheal yede hashshelosha yisreelim yitparsem haddabar lekol mi sheyyodea shehi behemat yisrael. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem bishat haddechaq, kegon mi sheyyesh lo sadot vei epshar lo littenan lenokri baarisut ella im ken yaskir lo gam shevarim lacharosh bahem, vei epshar lo lemono shello yacharosh bahem beshabbat, vegam i epshar lo lehattil alayv kol acharayut hashshevarim ap leinyan yoqer vezol umita beones al derek sheyyitbaer — azay yesh lehattir lo sheyyapqirem bipne g'. Vetob lehorot lo sheyyapqirem bipne dayyane hair, vehem yepareshu lo inyan hahepqer, sheyyapqirem beleb male, velo yitba min hannokri apillu im al yede peshiuto yeera bahem hepsed beshabbat, vehem yeparsemu hahepqer lakkol, shello yihyeh chashash marit haayin. Veken yesh lehattir letzorek mitzva, kegon lishloach etrogim al behemto al yede nokri, al derek sheyyitbaer besimman trn"h, im mapqir behemto bipne shelosha. Veim i epshar lo — yakol lehapqir apillu beno leben atzmo, shellidbar mitzva en lachush lemarit haayin. Abal shello letzorek mitzva veshello bishat haddechaq — en lehattir lekattechilla, apillu rotzeh leparsem larabbim shemmapqirah, o shemmaqneh gup habbehema lehannokri leyom hashshabbat, lepi sheepshar sheyyimmatzeu harbeh sheyyodeim mehassekirut vehashsheela shehen lekol yemot hashshabua, veenan yodeim mehahapqara vehahaqnaa shehen leshabbat bilbad, veyeraeh lahem sheggam beshabbat hi sekura usheula bilbad lehannokri vegup habbehema shel yisrael kemo bekol yemot hashshabua. Abal im gam bimot hachol gup habbehema qanuy lehannokri, ap al pi shello hiqna lo qinyan gamur sheyyehe reshut beyado lemokrah velitten lehayyisrael dameha, ella lo hiqna otah lo raq leinyan yoqer vezol veacharayut mita, dehaynu sheshsham otah bedamim lehannokri beshaa shehiskirah o hishilah lo, veim tityaqqer besop meshek zeman sekiruto o sheilato kesheyyachazirenna lehayyisrael yihyeh haodep lehannokri, veim tuzal yitchayyeb leshallem lo haodep mibbeto ap al pi shehu anus bezol zeh, veken im tamut apillu beones yitchayyeb leshallem, venimtza revach behema zo vechesronah hakkol lenokri keillu hayeta behemto mammash, lepikak en hayyisrael metzuvveh al shebitatah, sheap sheggup habbehema meshubad lo shello yukal hannokri lemokrah shello middato, mikkol maqom kol zeman shehi mechusseret gubayna, sheadayin lo gaba otah mibbet hannokri lebeto — hare hi kebehemat hannokri, kevan sheen lehayyisrael aleha ella shibud beolma, vekol chesronah verivchah lehannokri. Veen lachush lemarit haayin, kevan sheenah shel hannokri beshabbat lebad ella bekol zeman meshek sekiruto o sheiluto apillu bimot hachol, im ken hare zeh domeh lemoker behemto lenokri vehannokri oseh bah melaka beshabbat, sheen sham chashash marit haayin, lepi sheyyesh pirsum laddabar. Umikkol maqom, kevan shello mekarah lo mammash — yesh lo leparsem larabbim sheasa derek hetter, shekkol mah sheepshar lo laasot lehotzi et atzmo mide chashad — yesh lo laasot:

Veken yakol lehaskirah o lehashilah lenokri al yede sheyyazhir oto shello yaaseh bah beshabbat, ubeim sheyyaabor al tenao veyaaseh azay hi qenuya lo leyom hashshabbat veyitchayyeb beonasin sheyyeeru lah beshabbat, veyiktob ken bearkaotehem, shennimtza keshebba hannokri laasot bah beshabbat enah behemat yisrael kelal, shehare qenaah hannokri lehitchayyeb beonaseha. Veap sheenah qenuya lo ella beshabbat bilbad — en lachush lemarit haayin, kevan shekkatab ken bearkaotehem — yesh laddabar qol upirsum:

Yisrael venokri shehem shuttapim bibhema litchon barechayim vekayyotze — yesh hetter sheyyaaseh bah hannokri beshabbat al yede sheyyatneh im hannokri battechilla beshaa sheqqenauha sheyyittol hannokri kol sekar hashshabbat bilbaddo vehayyisrael yittol keneged zeh kol sekar yom echad bechol bilbaddo, shekkeshemmatneh immo ken bitchillat hashshuttaput — hare zeh kemaqneh lo bilbaddo kol gup habbehema leshabbatot uleyisrael bilbaddo beyom acher, veen lehayyisrael cheleq bah beshabbatot, veeno metzuvveh al shebitatah. Veim achar kak nitratztza hannokri meelayv lachaloq immo kol hassakar beshaveh — hare zeh muttar, kemo shennitbaer besimman rm"h. Vaapillu im acharayut habbehema hu al shenehem beshaveh kol yemot hashshabua apillu beshabbat — ap al pi ken en hayyisrael metzuvveh al shebitatah mechamat sheacharayutah gam alayv beshabbat, kevan shehitna immo sheyyittol kol sekar hashshabbat leatzmo — hare hi qenuya lo bilbaddo leshabbat, veen leyisrael cheleq bah kelal, umah sheacharayutah gam al hayyisrael zehu tenay achar shehirviach hayyisrael lehannokri mishshello veqibbel gam alayv acharayut hashshabbat, sheaz hi shel hannokri, vehannokri hirviach mishshello lehayyisrael, veqibbel gam alayv acharayut yom echad bechol, sheaz hi shel hayyisrael:

Veim lo hitna immo ken bitchillat hashshuttaput — lo yatneh immo achar kak, sheap im akshav en kan issur mishshum shebitat behemto, shehare akshav en hannokri nimna millaasot bah melaka beal korcho shel hayyisrael meachar shekkebar nishtattep veyesh lo cheleq bah, mikkol maqom yesh issur bemah shennotel revach yom echad bechol keneged yom hashshabbat, shehare notel sekar shabbat shello behablaa kemo shennitbaer besimman rm"h, ubikgon zeh shello hitnu mittechilla yoter — yesh hetter keshello yomar lo kelal "tol atta beshabbat vaani bechol", ella yachaloq immo kol harevach shel kol yemot hashshabua beshaveh, sheaz hu notel sekar shabbat behablaa. Ella sheggam zeh en lehattir ella bimqom hepsed gadol, im gam hannokri beatzmo tzarik laasot melaka beshabbat im habbehema vehayyisrael yaaseh kenegdo bechol, kemo shennitbaer sham:

Vegam bimqom hepsed gadol, o apillu eno rotzeh littol kelal bechol keneged hashshabbat, ap sheen issur mishshum sekar shabbat, velo mishshum shebitat behemto, meachar shehannokri eno nimna millaasot bah melaka beshabbat beal korcho shel hayyisrael, mikkol maqom yesh issur lemaprea bemah shennishtattep im hannokri bibhema shehannokri yaaseh bah melaka beshabbat beal korcho. Veyesh tiqqun lezeh al yede sheyyatneh immo sheim yaaseh bah melaka beshabbat — azay hi qenuya lo leyom hashshabbat, veyitchayyeb baonasin sheyyeeru beshabbat, veyiktob ken, kemo shennitbaer lemala, o al yede sheyyaqneh lo gam chelqo leinyan yoqer vezol umita beones, kemo shennitbaer lemala. O apillu yimkor lo chelqo bimkira gemura, veap al pi ken lo yukal hannokri lemokrah shello middato, kegon sheyyizqop alayv haddamim bemilva sheyyipraem lo kesheyyitbaennu, veyachazor hannokri veyaaseh lo behema zo appottiqi lechobo, dehaynu shekkol zeman shello yipra lo chobo bemaot lo yukal lesalleqo bedabar acher ki im bibhema zo, ulepikak kol zeman shello natan lo hammaot eno yakol lemokrah shello middato, veap al pi ken eno ober aleha mishshum shebitat behemto, kevan sheadayin lo gaba mimmennu behema zo leperaon (chobo), veen lo aleha ella shibud beolma. Veim hu rotzeh, yakol liqqach habbehema lebeto lemashkon leachar shezzaqap alayv haddamim bemilva, veyomar lo "im lo tipraeni chelqi bemaot kesheetbaaka tehe behema zo qenuya li az lehippara mimmenna chobi", veyachazor veyitten lo habbehema laabod bah. Ulepikak, kol zeman shello natan lo hammaot eno yakol lemokrah shello middato, veap al pi ken eno ober aleha mishshum shebitat behemto kol zeman shello tebao velo niqnet lo leperaon, ubilbad shello yomar lo "meakshav tehe qenuya li im lo tipraeni chelqi bemaot kesheetbaaka", lepi shekkesheyyitbaennu chelqo bishat chaluqqa, o kesheyyeera bah hepsed, o kesheyyirtzeh hannokri lemokrah velo yipra lo bemaot — nimtza shellemaprea hayeta qenuya leyisrael, veabar aleha mishshum shebitat behemto:

Uben sheasaa appottiqi uben shello asaah, uben shennetalah lemashkon uben shello netalah, ella mekarah lo bimkira gemura sheyyehe reshut beyado lemokrah shello middato, kevan shekkol zeman shello mekarah hem shuttapim bah veyesh chashash marit ayin, lepikak yesh lo leparsem larabbim sheasa derek hetter:
Hetter zeh shel asiyyat appottiqi, o sheyyittelah lemashkon, moil ap keshekkol habbehema hi shel yisrael umaskirah o mashilah lenokri, raq sheyyeparsem sheasa derek hetter:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshemmaskirah o mashilah lo laasot meleket atzmo, abal laasot meleket yisrael beshabbat en hetter kelal apillu im mekarah lo bimkira gemura, shemmikkol maqom hannokri oseh melaka beshabbat bishbil hayyisrael im lo qatzatz lo sakar al zeh. Veken im hu sekiro leshana lekol hammelakot sheyyitztarek, sheddino keillu lo qatzatz, kemo shennitbaer besimman rm"g veram"d. Abal im eno sakur lo ella limlaka zo bilbad, laasotah lo bekol et sheyyitztarek lah betok meshek zeman sekiruto, kegon mi sheyyesh lo susim vaagala vesakar lo nokri leshana sheyyissa im susim vaagala shello bekol et sheyyitztarek leholik bahem sechora betok shana zo, vehannokri nosea gam beshabbat meatzmo belo amirat hayyisrael — eno tzarik lomar lo shello yissa beshabbat im nosea mibbet hayyisrael mibbeod yom, mittaam shennitbaer besimman rm"d. Raq sheyyaqneh lo hassusim beechad mehadderakim shennitbaaru, viparsem sheasa derek hetter. Vehu sheyyihyu qenuyim lo gam bimot hachol betok meshek zeman nesiato, abal im eno maqneh lo ella leshabbat bilbad — asur mippene marit haayin, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Veken im hu atzmo nosea gam ken im hassusim kol yemot hachol umezonotehem alayv — hare hem niqraim al shemo ap al pi shemmekaram lehannokri bimkira gemura ap limot hachol, kevan shehannokri eno ella sekiro, ulepikak tzarik hu limchot beyado shello yissa beshabbat mippene marit haayin:

Keshem sheadam metzuvveh al shebitat behemto beshabbat — kak hu metzuvveh al shebitatah beyom tob. Lepikak, kol perate hahalakot shennitbaaru leinyan sheela usekirut behemto lenokri veshuttaput immo gabbe shabbat, hen nohagim gam ken gabbe yom tob, sheen ben yom tob leshabbat ella melakot shehutteru biglal okel nepesh, shenneemar "kol melaka lo yeaseh bahem, ak asher yeakel lekol nepesh vego'". Veyesh omerim shebbeyom tob en adam metzuvveh min hattora al shebitat behemto, lepi shello nitztavvinu beyom tob ella shello naaseh melaka, umah shebbehemtenu osa en zo niqret melaka etzlenu ella etzel habbehema, veap beshabbat lo lamadnu issur zeh mimmah shenneemar "lo taaseh kol melaka", sheen zo melaka kelal etzlenu, ella mitzva acheret hi, shenneemar "lemaan yanuach shoreka vachamoreka", veenah noheget beyom tob kelal. Vehu haddin lishbitat abdo sheenah noheget beyom tob lepi dibrehem, lepi sheenah biklal melaka ella mitzva acheret hi, shenneemar "lemaan yanuach abdeka vaamateka kamoka". Uleinyan halaka, yesh lehachamir beshel tora kisbara harishona (ayyen simman ttz"h):
